title: Regulatory Oversight and Operational Control of Warehouses
summary: The concept of warehouse management has evolved from basic physical control and custodial responsibility to a more structured, audit-driven regulatory framework. While early provisions focused on the physical security and movement of goods, recent updates integrate formal definitions and audit-based compliance mechanisms to ensure transparency in bonded operations.

evolution.regulatory_focus: Shifted from passive custodial control to active audit-based oversight.
evolution.legal_basis: Transitioned from general customs provisions to specific definitions under the Customs Act 2023 framework.

timeline.change: Introduction of formal audit responsibilities for warehouse operations, focusing on security, record-keeping, and inventory verification.
Formalization of definitions regarding warehouse storage periods and bonded institution classifications under the Customs Act 2023.

২৭ । নিরীক্ষকের দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য:

(১) নিরীক্ষকগণ দৈবচয়ন গুদামে রক্ষিত আটককৃত পণ্যের তথ্যাদি যাচাই ও নিশ্চিত করবেন।

(২) নিরীক্ষকালে শুল্ক গুদামের নিরাপত্তা ব্যবস্থা যথেষ্ট আছে কি'না উক্ত বিষয় যাচাই করে প্রতিবেদন প্রেরণ করবেন।

(৩) শুল্ক গুদামের ব্যবহৃত রেজিস্টার যথাযথভাবে এন্ট্রি প্রদান ও সংরক্ষিত কি'না তা যাচাই করবেন।

(৪) নিরীক্ষকালে পণ্য সংরক্ষণ, অনলাইনের তথ্য বা আদেশ অনুযায়ী নিষ্পত্তিয়োগ্য পণ্য ব্যবহৃত না হলে প্রয়োজনীয় সুপারিশমালা প্রেরণ করবেন।

Customs Audit: The auditor is responsible for verifying information regarding detained goods stored in warehouses using random sampling techniques.
The auditor must assess the adequacy of security measures within the customs warehouse and submit a formal report.
The auditor is required to inspect whether all mandatory registers for the customs warehouse are being maintained and updated correctly.
The auditor shall provide necessary recommendations if they identify discrepancies between stored goods, online data, or administrative orders regarding the disposal of goods.
Customs Warehouse: The warehouse must maintain proper security standards and ensure all operational registers are accurately recorded and preserved for audit purposes.
Goods held within the warehouse are subject to audit verification and must comply with online documentation or disposal orders.

Customs Act 2023: The term Act is defined as the Customs Act 2023 for the purpose of these rules.
Warehouse Storage Period: This term refers to the specific duration allowed for storing goods in various classes of warehouses as prescribed under these rules.
Bonded Enterprise for Domestic Consumpti: This refers to an enterprise that processes raw materials imported under bond facilities and supplies the finished products for domestic consumption upon payment of applicable duties and taxes.
